title: Glue local maps between fixed ambient objects on an open union
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], W and V opens of X, and fix derived categories of module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category] in common Hom universe w on X, W, V, W intersect V and W union V. All direct restrictions, relative restrictions, and composition isomorphisms below are the canonical ones of [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let G and E be fixed objects of D(O_X). Write L, JW and JV for direct restrictions from X to W union V, W and V. Write PW and PV for relative restriction from W union V to W and V, and SW and SV for relative restriction from W and V to W intersect V. The isomorphisms kW : L followed by PW isomorphic to JW, kV : L followed by PV isomorphic to JV, sW : JW followed by SW isomorphic to direct overlap restriction, and sV : JV followed by SV isomorphic to direct overlap restriction are canonical. Suppose a : JW(G) to JW(E) and b : JV(G) to JV(E) satisfy sW(G) inverse followed by SW(a) followed by sW(E) = sV(G) inverse followed by SV(b) followed by sV(E). Then there is alpha : L(G) to L(E) such that PW(alpha) followed by kW(E) = kW(G) followed by a and PV(alpha) followed by kV(E) = kV(G) followed by b. There is no assertion of uniqueness or of a map G to E on all of X.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-mayer-vietoris-hom, exactness at the local Hom pair, applied on W union V

proof.text: Construct U and T as inverse images of W and V under (W union V).ι. Prove they cover the union by preimage_sup and ι_preimage_self. Apply open_union_restriction_transport to obtain local derived categories, equivalences eW,eV, natural restriction comparisons qW,qV, and compatibility of the full-faithful preimages a′,b′ of the conjugated local maps.

Apply scheme_derived_hom_gluing on the union scheme to L(G), L(E), a′,b′ and their compatibility. It constructs alpha with the two pulled-back restrictions equal to a′,b′. The proved private helper transported_morphism_eq applies the equivalence functor to these equations, uses map_preimage and naturality of qW,qV, and cancels their inverses to recover PW(alpha)=kW(G);a;kW(E) inverse and the corresponding V equation. Compose with kW(E), kV(E) and cancel the inverse pairs to obtain the conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08BW applied on the union; transport separated into lem-sc-open-union-restriction-transport, cover and final cancellation fully proved.

theorem exists_open_union_hom
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (G E : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    let L := (schemeOpenRestriction X (W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let JW := (schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory
    let JV := (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory
    let SW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)).mapDerivedCategory
    let SV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let sW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)
    let sV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    let PW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let PV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let kW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)
    let kV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)
    ∀ (a : JW.obj G ⟶ JW.obj E) (b : JV.obj G ⟶ JV.obj E),
      sW.inv.app G ≫ SW.map a ≫ sW.hom.app E =
        sV.inv.app G ≫ SV.map b ≫ sV.hom.app E →
      ∃ (α : L.obj G ⟶ L.obj E),
        PW.map α ≫ kW.hom.app E = kW.hom.app G ≫ a ∧
        PV.map α ≫ kV.hom.app E = kV.hom.app G ≫ b
